scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,dashboard -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/gateway && npm run build -w apps/stream-processor && npm run build -w apps/dashboard && npm run build -w apps/rider
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/dashboard && npm run lint -w apps/rider
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); let dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL; if (!dbUrl) { try { const envContent = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '.env'), 'utf8'); const m = envContent.match(/^DATABASE_URL=(.+)$/m); if (m) dbUrl = m[1].trim(); } catch (e) {} } if (!dbUrl) dbUrl = 'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/emoto_fleet?sslmode=disable'; const env = { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'test', REDIS_IN_MEMORY: 'true', NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX_INLINE: 'true', MQTT_DISABLED: 'true', SINOTRACK_ENABLED: 'false', AUTH_REGISTER_ENABLED: 'true', AUTH_PUBLIC_REGISTER_ENABLED: 'true', DATABASE_URL: dbUrl }; spawnSync('npm', ['run', 'db:push', '-w', 'apps/api'], { stdio: 'inherit', env, shell: true }); const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', 'test:e2e', '-w', 'apps/api', '--', '--runInBand', '--testTimeout=90000'], { stdio: 'inherit', env, shell: true }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.db:seed: echo "ERROR: db:seed is disabled on this project to prevent unauthorized seeding." && exit 1
